reviews.text:
⭐ 1/5 Stars — Left Stranded with Toddler — Zero Support
Date: 29 October 2026 | Booking Reference: 9MKPUN — Edinburgh → Doha → Abu Dhabi

I booked this trip through Trip.com hoping for a smooth journey to visit family in India — instead, my family and I were left completely stranded at Edinburgh Airport, and Trip.com offered absolutely zero help or support.

I arrived with my wife and 2-year-old daughter to check in. The airline staff refused to accept my passport because of how my names appear — even though it's a perfectly legal, government-issued document. We were denied boarding and left stuck at the airport.

I immediately contacted Trip.com for help. Despite explaining we had a tired toddler, missed our connecting flight, and were stranded — there was no urgent assistance, no solution, and no support offered. I waited 7.5 hours at the airport while my little girl fell asleep on the floor — all the while Trip.com could do nothing to help rebook, offer alternatives, or even speak to the airline on my behalf.

We missed our entire trip, a special family gathering, and suffered hours of stress and humiliation. When things went wrong, Trip.com simply washed their hands of it — "contact the airline" was the only answer. That's not support — that's letting your customers down when they need you most.

If things go smoothly, maybe it's fine. But the moment you actually need help — especially in an emergency situation — you are completely on your own. Not even the basic courtesy

One of the worst booking experiences I’ve ever had. Do not book flights through Trip.com.

We booked our Vietnam Airlines flight from Ho Chi Minh City to Da Nang for 11:45 AM on October 5, specifically because that timing worked for our trip. Less than 24 hours before departure, Trip.com informed us that we had been moved to a 6:00 PM flight, completely disrupting our plans.

What made this even more frustrating was that when we checked Vietnam Airlines, there were still multiple flights operating throughout the day. We asked Trip.com to move us to an earlier flight — first around 9:00 AM, then 10:15 AM, and later 3:30 PM — and the requests kept getting rejected.

The customer support experience made everything worse. We spent hours contacting them, being placed on hold repeatedly, speaking to agents who seemed unable to explain what was happening or provide any useful solution. This was happening at the last minute, while we were supposed to be enjoying our holiday, instead of constantly chasing Trip.com for answers.

We booked through Trip.com expecting them to manage our booking properly when something went wrong. Instead, they added even more stress and wasted a huge amount of our time.

I would give 0 stars if I could. After this experience, I would rather book directly with the airline than use Trip.com again. They made what should have been a simple domestic flight incredibly stressful.

The Derby ticket was the same price, but they still refused to change the destination, and cancellation would only return up to 20% as a voucher.

Two problems within one week, and both times Trip.com support was extremely disappointing. When something goes wrong, they seem more interested in passing responsibility around than actually solving the problem. I will not be using Trip.com again.

They sent the email from an unmonitored "do-not-reply" address. When you reply, it vanishes into the void, triggering an endless automated loop of the exact same message.
 
* Scare Tactics: When I filed a chargeback with my bank, Trip.com turned around and sent automated emails falsely claiming my payment was "declined" and demanding I cancel the bank dispute.

Instead of fixing their own broken systems or auditing their scammy vendors, they rely on automated scare tactics to keep your money. I got my funds back through my bank instantly, but I will never use this app again. Stick to reputable platforms.

Trip.com deceptively stitches together tickets from un-partnered airlines into "Self-Transfer Packages" without clearly warning you at checkout that you will be forced to clear international border control and claim/re-check luggage.
I booked a flight from Dubai to Cairo for my family. Because the app hid the reality of the self-transfer requirements during booking, we were stopped at the airport because we didn't hold a transit visa to physically enter Saudi Arabia just to get our bags checked.
My entire family including young children was left stranded, forced to bear a massive financial loss and buy brand-new tickets to get home.
To make matters worse, their customer support is completely useless. They loop automated, copy-paste email templates asking for visa documents rather than addressing their app's misleading layout and lack of transparency.
Avoid this app if you value your time, money, and peace of mind when traveling with family.

How does that make any sense when there were no available flights and the airspace itself was closed? Customers cannot rebook flights that literally do not exist.

They shifted the responsibility to me, saying I should have checked directly with the airline before booking, which is not reasonable since the booking was made through Trip.com and it is their responsibility to clearly inform customers of any important restrictions before payment.

I strongly advise others to carefully check all details before booking through this platform, as my experience was unfair and very disappointing.

I strongly urge customers to review the cancellation terms very carefully before booking through this platform.

I cancelled a flight booking within seconds of confirmation. No service was used, no ticket was flown, and no reasonable operational cost could have been incurred. Despite this, I was informed that almost the entire ticket amount would be deducted, leaving only a negligible refund.

Deducting nearly the full fare for an immediate cancellation appears excessive and raises serious concerns regarding fairness and transparency. Under consumer protection principles, cancellation fees should be proportionate and reflect actual costs incurred. In this case, the deduction seems unreasonable.

The matter has been escalated internally, and I am awaiting resolution. However, the initial response has been deeply disappointing.

Customers deserve clear, fair, and proportionate policies — especially when cancellations are made immediately.

Until this is resolved appropriately, I cannot recommend this platform.
